_note: Post formats (2026-10-16). content/formats.py picks one per post (seeded by the Content ID): never the format of the last 2 posts on that platform, Roman at most 1 in 3, needsNumber only with a sourced number in the research, no Roman when the image provider cannot show him; 'as <format>' overrides. Zones (shares of the canvas, kinds big_number, headline, subline, list, two_column, question, quote) are rendered by workflows/text_overlay.py; the image prompt asks for empty space and no text. Fields not used by a zone (illustration, source) are not rendered. li_classic is the current design-system layout.
imageRules: No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or labels anywhere in the picture. Keep these areas calm, dark and empty, because the text is added there later: {areas}. Keep the top right corner empty for the logo.
